text:
marie: Quick kickoff — cloud storefront listing onboarding for AWS / GCP / Azure. Need clarity on networking, KMS, and packaging bundle that legal will accept. cc @devon @sam

devon: +1. Is there a single manifest we should publish or separate SKUs per cloud?

sam: prefer separate SKUs. legal asked for explicit EULA link per region. also need marketplace role ARNs for AWS.

ana: For GCP we need publisher contact and service account json upload. I can draft the JSON schema.

marie: devon can you paste the minimal role ARNs? Also we need a VPC endpoint checklist for asset pulls.

devon: AWS role ARNs (example): arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodMarketplacePublishRole

# VPC checklist (high level):
1) NAT/egress + route table for internet-bound fetches
2) S3 VPC endpoint for packaging and assets
3) KMS key ID & policy with CMK alias = alias/redwood-marketplace-prod
4) Security group allowing egress on 443 to partner endpoints

ryan: legal asks: confirm EULA link, mention DPA if customer data, and support contact format. tagging @lucy for packaging copy and blurbs.

lucy: Packaging copy draft uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link. I'll propose trial SKU names and short 1-line descriptions per SKU.

ops-bot: staging upload complete — s3://redwood-marketplace-staging/4987654321/package.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

sam: Could we include a minimal manifest snippet for the publisher portal?

sam: ```
name: redwood-inference
version: 1.0.0
skus:
  - sku_id: RW-DED-1
    cloud: aws
  - sku_id: RW-DED-GCP-1
    cloud: gcp
  - sku_id: RW-DED-AZ-1
    cloud: azure
```

ana: That looks fine. I'll coordinate the service account upload and publisher contact with GCP onboarding next Tue 10am PT.

marie: Action items: devon to create AWS role + CMK alias by Fri EOD, lucy to finalize packaging copy and trial mapping by Thu, ana to schedule GCP service-account upload. I'll ping legal for the EULA link and confirm DPA language. :thumbsup:

ryan: noted and added to marketplace tracker — https://confluence.redwood/marketplace/onboard/4987654321

marie: Thanks everyone. If there are no blockers by EOD Friday we aim to submit the staging packages to the vendor portals on Monday.
